shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them, hosts HugsLib's and Archotech Logs' log-window buttons in a suite-styled add-on tray, and can throttle runaway log spam. Plus a knowledge-base browser, in-game bug/fix reporting, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, impact scoring, content-fingerprint mod-change detection, and a public v2 API for other mods.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Version constant `1.3`; v1.2 is live on the Workshop.**

### Governing rule: everything shown is a factual claim
This mod tells players which mod broke their game and whether a mod changed. People act on it. The house rules that follow from that:
- **Fail closed.** When evidence is incomplete, say nothing and say *why*, rather than guessing.
- **A match string must be provably reachable from `Log`.** Existing in decompiled source is a weaker test — see the audit below.
- **Never re-derive an identity you already held.** Record the name/id at the moment you observed it.

---

## Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`, gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`. List (culled) + inspector + add-on tray. Toolbar B is a right-to-left cursor: Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, **Vanilla log** (only when a decorator is detected), search fills the rest. Compat hint strip is **frame-latched** (`_hintFrame`). Repeat chip shows `x{repeats}+{suppressed}` in Warn colour.

### Log-window ownership + interop
Replacing the vanilla log silently deleted other mods' UI. Detected by TYPE presence, not packageId.
- **HugsLib** — `LogWindowExtensions.AddLogWindowWidget` is the community hook. `LogWidgets` reflects its private `widgets` list and rebinds each `Drawer` via `Delegate.CreateDelegate` to our identically-shaped `LogWidgetDrawer` (not `DynamicInvoke`). Drawn in a recessed-well tray; throwing widgets dropped. `LogWidgets.Any` is frame-latched (the tray sizes the body rect).
- **Archotech Logs** — `ArchotechBridge` hosts its Diagnostics/Export windows. `Dialog_ArchotechInfoView(EditWindow_Log)` uses the host only for positioning and both consumers null-check it, so **passing null is supported**. Its `DoWindowContents` reads the private **static** `EditWindow_Log.selectedMessage`, so `LogState.Selected` raises `SelectionChanged` and `ArchotechBridge` mirrors into that static.
- `yieldLogWindow` setting = full stand-down. Tray restyle: on-demand prefix on the 7-arg `Widgets.ButtonText` funnel, gated on `LogWidgets.Drawing`, control-count safe, honours `drawBackground:false`, fails open.

### `LogThrottle` — optional suppression of repeating lines (default OFF)
`Log.Error/Warning/Message` evaluate `StackTraceUtility.ExtractStackTrace()` as an ARGUMENT, before `Enqueue` can notice a repeat; below the cap of 99 every occurrence also does a synchronous disk write; all inside `lock(logLock)`. **`LogMessageQueue` only combines with `lastMessage`**, so dedupe is strictly consecutive — interleaved spam (A,B,A,B) never combines. Allocation-free FNV-1a + 64-slot ring; first `Threshold`(5) pass; 10s quiet window resets; `Environment.TickCount` (Log.Error can be off-thread); own short lock; fails open and latches off. Summaries drained from the `Root.Update` hook, never from the prefix. Suppressed counts surface in the chip/tooltip and `ImpactAssessor.EffectiveRepeats` folds them into severity. Test actions include the two-interleaved-lines case vanilla cannot collapse.

---

## Attribution pipeline
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`. 13 modules in flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`. `ErrorContext.RankedMods()` cached, invalidated by `Merge`.

- `Module_StackTrace` — frames → owning assembly; falls back to `NamespaceRoot` (only when exactly ONE loaded mod declares that root; `FrameParser.FrameworkRoots` blocks a mod that IL-merges `System.*`/`Newtonsoft.*` from claiming the root).
- `Module_LogPrefix` — `[ModName]` tags via `InstalledModIndex.MatchTag`, which requires an unambiguous match to a single ACTIVE mod.
- `Module_MessageMentions` — the three vanilla `Mod X …` grammars, packageId tokens, mod folders in paths.
- `Module_HarmonyPatches` — reverse index of patched methods → owner ids. Conflict claim needs ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace.
- `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_Community`, `Module_Glossary`, `Module_CircinusCorpus`, `Module_ReflectionBridge`.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > KnownIssues n−i (benign +1000). Context-only modules (incl. reflection bridges) must score **< 1**.

### Impact scoring (`ImpactAssessor`)
Tick/frame signals prove *where*, not *how often*; a perf claim requires recurrence. `RepeatingThreshold=3`, `SpamThreshold=10`. Curated `MaxImpact` caps the level. **"Known issue" badge = `Diagnoses.Any(d => d.FromLibrary)`**, set only by KnownIssues/ModIssues/CommunityBugs.

### `IssueScoring` — ONE matcher for all four knowledge surfaces
Weights (ExceptionType 3 / Regex 3 / Keyword 2 / Namespace 2 / PackageId 2) in one place, shared by the shipped library, mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json`, API-registered sources and the community DB. Keyword tests use allocation-free `OrdinalIgnoreCase` `IndexOf`. `IssueTextUtil` holds `StripBom`/`Lower`/`CompileRegexes`/`PairKey`. `RegexOptions.Compiled` deliberately dropped in the shared compiler (Mono emits IL via Reflection.Emit, never reclaimed); FrameParser's per-line patterns keep it.

---

## Correctness audit — 2026-11 (four passes: mod-change, attribution, knowledge DBs, docs)
Triggered by a user report: a mod last updated in January was flagged **updated**. Findings and fixes:

### 1. Mod-change detection — REWRITTEN (`ModFingerprint` + `ModChange`)
**Root cause of the false positive:** the snapshot token was `Directory.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(mcp.RootDir).Ticks`. That is not a measure of content in either direction — a directory's write time changes when a *direct child entry* is created/deleted/renamed (Steam re-downloading identical bytes, a copy/restore, a library move, any tool writing beside the mod), and does **not** change when a file deep inside is edited. Steam also stamps the **local download time**, never the author's publish date, so a January mod routinely carries a recent timestamp.

Four further defects in the same 90 lines:
- `token = ""` on any stat failure, then compared against a real value → "updated" from zero evidence. Failed *open* into a false claim.
- `NameOf(pid)` re-derived the display name via `ModLister.GetModWithIdentifier(pid, ignorePostfix: true)`. That dictionary is keyed on the **stripped** id, so any `_steam` id returns null (raw packageId rendered); and it returns `ElementAtOrDefault(0)`, which — since local mods are added before Workshop mods — is always the **local** copy. The name shown could belong to a different copy than the one that changed.
- `d[pid] = token` last-writer-wins, and `PackageId` itself flips between `foo.bar` and `foo.bar_steam` as unrelated local copies come and go → phantom Removed+Added pairs.
- `saved` deserialized with the default ordinal comparer while `cur` was OrdinalIgnoreCase (latent; ids are lowercased today).

**Now:** `ModFingerprint` computes FNV-1a 64 over the sorted list of (relative path, file **length**) for every file under the mod's roots. **No timestamps anywhere**, so re-downloads/copies/restores/library moves reproduce the same hash. Runs on a low-priority background thread started from `Bootstrap`; depth-capped at 24 (mod folders are often symlinks — Modmixer symlinks them); excludes `.git/.svn/.hg/.vs/.idea/obj/bin/node_modules`; 40k files per mod. **Any unreadable directory or over-budget mod ⇒ UNKNOWN, never a guess.** Official Ludeon content is presence-tracked only (patched every game update; Core is tens of thousands of files).
- Keys are `_steam`-normalized; local+Steam copies of one id are hashed **together**, so moving a mod between `Mods/` and the Workshop is not a change.
- The display **name is recorded in the save** from the loaded `ModContentPack`, never re-derived.
- Snapshot is versioned (`mdtSnapshotVersion` + new node `mdtModSnapshotV2`); a snapshot from a different algorithm version is **discarded, not compared**. The old `mdtModSnapshot` node is left unread.
- Diff rules: Removed/Added from presence (always reliable); **Updated only when BOTH fingerprints are known and differ**; anything else counts as `Unverified` and is shown as a footer, not a row. Per-row tooltip states the evidence.
- Deferred completion via `ModChange.TickPending()` on the permanent `Root.Update` postfix, since the scan is async.
- Setting `detectModChanges` (default on) in the General card.
- **Accepted limit:** an edit preserving every file's exact byte length is invisible. Deliberate — false negatives are far less harmful than false accusations.

### 2. Third-party knowledge files could claim another mod's error — FIXED
`Module_ModIssues` scored every `About/known-issues.json` entry against every error, awarded the **highest score in the scale** (9+) and set `FromLibrary=true` (the "Known issue" badge). One mod shipping `"keywords": ["NullReferenceException"]` would take the top diagnosis slot for every unrelated error in the game and blame the wrong author. `RemoteIssue` now carries `OwnerPackageId` (set by `ModShippedIssues`) and `HasExplicitScope`; a shipped entry applies only when the error implicates its owner, or it names its own packageIds/namespaces (the legitimate "my dependency throws this" case). API-registered sources are exempt — registration is a deliberate code-level act.

### 3. Wrong-copy attribution in `InstalledModIndex` — FIXED
`ByName`/`ByFolder`/`ByPackageId` were first-writer-wins. An old **inactive** local copy alongside the active Workshop one could win the key — and that copy then answers everything asked about the result, including `Module_VersionMismatch` reading **its** About.xml, producing a confident "does not support 1.6" about a mod that supports it fine. `Put()` now prefers the ACTIVE mod.

### 4. Lazy regex truncated mod names — FIXED
The three vanilla `^Mod (.+?) …` grammars (in `Module_MessageMentions` and three `attributeRegex` entries) stop at the FIRST occurrence of the literal, so a mod whose name contains it yields a truncated name matching no installed mod, shown as a culprit that does not exist. Switched to greedy `(.+)` with the full trailing literal anchored — vanilla emits the literal once, at the end.

### 5. Phantom match strings — the big knowledge-DB finding
The 2026-08 audit verified strings **exist in Core**. That is weaker than the test that matters: **is the string reachable from `Log`?** Two classes fail it:
- **`GetModWarnings()` output** (`ModsConfig.cs:513`) — `ModIncompatibleWithTip`, `ModMustLoadBefore/After`, `ModUnsatisfiedDependency`, `ModWithSameIdAlreadyActive` — is consumed only by `Page_ModsConfig.cs:337` for the mod-list tooltip. Never logged. **`MDT_Incompatible` (all 5 keywords) removed**; its broadest keyword was the ordinary English phrase "incompatible with", which matched any mod's prose and was then presented as curated knowledge. Nothing lost: `Module_DependencyCheck` + `Module_AboutIncompat` produce the same information proactively from About.xml/ModsConfig.
- **`loadErrors` lists** — detailed per-file translation errors go to the *translation report*; the log gets only the COUNT (`LoadedLanguage.cs:566`). `MDT_MissingTranslation`'s "tried to translate field" replaced with "generate translation report for more info".

Also removed as non-existent: "found no type named" (engine only says "Could not find type named"), "failed to find a node", and "xpath" (`PatchOperationPathed.ToString()` is `$"{base.ToString()}({xpath})"` — it interpolates the xpath *value*, never the word).

**`Module_DependencyCheck.MissingRefSignals` had never been audited at all** (the pass covered `Defs/`, not the C# string lists). 3 of 8 entries were phantoms, including `"could not find def named"` — standing in for the single most common cascade in RimWorld. The real string is `"Failed to find <Type> named X. There are N defs of this type loaded."` (`DefDatabase.cs:217`). Because the list is an OR-gate these were silent **false negatives**, not false claims. Rebuilt with every entry anchored to a verified `Log` call site.

Defs now: `KnownIssueDefs.xml` 42 (was 43), `BenignLogDefs.xml` 5, `ErrorModules.xml` 13, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` 17.

### Known-remaining, NOT fixed (documented honestly)
- `Module_Community` tests incompatibilities with `ModsConfig.IsActive(other)` using community-DB ids that never carry `_steam`; a Steam-postfixed mod silently misses. False negative only.
- Engine dictionaries use `CurrentCultureIgnoreCase` and `packageIdLowerCase` uses culture-sensitive `ToLower()`, while our indexes use `OrdinalIgnoreCase`. Disagreement possible under a Turkish locale (dotted/dotless I). Unverified.
- Two ACTIVE mods sharing an identical display name remain a coin flip in `ExactName`.
- `ModDependencyIndex.AddOrder` mirrors `ModsConfig.FindConflicts` by reading; exact parity is **unverified**.

---

## Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` banned suite-wide except the dev palette's category line. Icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. Helpers: `SearchField`, `ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`/`DrawWell`/`DrawPlate`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `DrawCheck`, `ModuleRow`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`/`ResetGuiState`.
- Never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window`. Size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.
- **`DrawPlate` (2-draw card)** gated to `Prefs.UIScale == 1f`, where `AdjustRectToUIScaling` reduces to floor/ceil so it is provably pixel-identical. *Unverified at 125/150%.*
- **`BeginScroll` is re-entrant** (skin styles on a STACK — `ErrorModule.DrawSection` runs inside the inspector's live scroll view). `ResetGuiState()` unwinds strays; all 12 scroll sites in try/finally.

### `TextMetrics`
Memoised `Text.CalcHeight`/`CalcSize`, keyed on (text, rounded width, resolved GameFont, that style's fontSize, WordWrap). `Text.Font`'s getter returns the *coerced* font (Tiny→Small when `TinyFontSupported` is false), so an accessibility change can't serve a stale metric. Cap-then-clear at 8192. Main thread only.

## Tool 4: knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited. **Viewport-culled** — `BeginScrollView` clips pixels but doesn't skip draw code, so cards measure (memoised) but skip drawing outside a **frame-latched** window (`UpdateCullWindow`, 300px margin). Def counts cached. Glossary ~26 terms; `AllTerms()` cached.

## Tools 2/3: dev actions + palette
`Window_ModernDevActions` (3-tab, vanilla node graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search). `Window_ModernDevPalette` — resolved nodes cached against a hash of `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette`. Pin/reorder sets `_pendingResizeFrame`, applied at the top of a LATER frame (changing row count mid-frame shifts IMGUI ids).

## Hardening + `HardeningPatches` (on-demand patching)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, off by default. All 7 hardening patches, 3 throttle prefixes and the tray restyle install only while their feature is on. **One permanent patch: a postfix on `Verse.Root.Update`** driving `SyncIfNeeded()` + `LogThrottle.DrainSummaries()` + `ModChange.TickPending()`. Apply MUST happen there, never from the settings UI (which runs *inside* two of the targets). Failures latch `_broken`. Validated in-game run #221.

## Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json. `LogAnalysisCache.Clear()` raises a volatile `_dirty` flag; the swap happens on the next main-thread read.

## Public API v2 (`ModernDevToolsAPI`) — frozen contract
`ApiVersion = 2`. v1: `RegisterModule`, `Invalidate`. v2: `RegisterKnowledgeSource(IKnownIssueSource)`, `RegisterLogWidget(id, drawer, alignRight)`, `AnalysisCompleted` event, `ModernOwnsLogWindow`, `IsModernLogOpen`, `OpenModernLog()`, `YieldLogWindow()`. Reflection-bindable. `LogWidgetDrawer` is signature-identical to HugsLib's `WidgetDrawer`. Documented in `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md`.
**Note:** the mod-shipped-file scoping change (audit item 2) narrows real-world behaviour of `About/known-issues.json` without changing any signature. Needs a line in the author docs.

## Settings surfaces — parity contract
`SettingsPage.Draw` is the canonical superset; `Dialog_Modules` is the quick subset. Both share `Palette.ModuleRow` + `SettingsPage.ToggleModule`. Cards: Log window, Log spam, General (now incl. `detectModChanges`), Modules, Ignored, Community, Experimental hardening. `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

## Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.

## State: 1.3 built, audit applied, NOT yet run in-game
Builds clean. Runs #221/#222/#223 (pre-audit) returned zero captured errors with HugsLib + Archotech Logs loaded.
**Unverified after the 2026-11 audit — nothing below has been launched:** (a) `ModFingerprint` background scan on a ~900-mod list (cost and completion time unmeasured); (b) the new snapshot round-trip through Scribe; (c) the deferred `TickPending` recompute; (d) the mod-shipped-issue scoping filter; (e) tray restyle to suite gray; (f) Archotech Diagnostics/Export tray buttons + selection mirroring; (g) the spam throttle actually suppressing; (h) nothing has been profiled; (i) 2-draw card at 125/150% UI scale.

## Release / publishing
v1.2 is live: Workshop 3771602203, git `98f6ca6` on `Astryls/ModernDevTools`. 1.3 prepped: version bumped, `MDT_UpdateNotesBody` rewritten (now includes an "Accuracy fixes" section), About.xml gained "Plays well with other log mods" + "Optional: throttle log spam" + author-API line, `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` updated, RootCauseAnalysis.md gained a full API v2 section.
**Community DB synced:** `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/main/known-issues.json` (a staging folder, NOT a git clone) regenerated from the audited `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 entries. **User action: push that folder to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`** or the opt-in fetch keeps overwriting good local data with bad.

## GitHub Backup
MIT. Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked.
